content.comment_body: Is it possible to create a system to monitor and analyze current and voltage for long-term reporting and detection of fluctuations, drops, and disturbances?

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Please note, this is an English-speaking forum, so kindly use English in future posts. Thank you. In principle, what you describe is possible, but it depends on the specific details and requirements you have, which are currently too general to provide a precise answer.

Translation from Italian (thanks to Google Translate): Hello, the [company_name] automation forum includes members from many countries, most of whom do not speak Italian as their first language. English has been chosen as our common language to support communication, so please use English in your next visit. Which model of [product_name] controller are you using, and are you planning to use the [product_name] itself for this analyzer? Hope this helps, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is asking about creating a network analyzer and long-term monitor for current and voltage using [company_name] products, specifically for compiling reports and identifying issues like surges and electrical disturbances. Responses request more specific technical requirements and information about the particular [product_name] controller version being used, but do not provide concrete product recommendations or solutions.
